description: The sources System knowledge is read from, as the Sources tab lists them: the agent's system prompts, its tools and its documentation. Each has an id, a kind, a name, where it came from (origin: code from the coding agent setup, manual when added by hand, connector from the connection settings, trace when first seen in traces), its current version, whether it is retired, and when a conversation last showed it. Use get_source to read one.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
